# Farmers Mill

> Freshly milled stoneground chakki atta, single-origin cold spices, traditional wood-pressed oils, raw honey, and handcrafted pickles sourced directly from Indian organic farmer cooperatives.

## Core Truths & Values
- **Milling Methodology**: Grains are slow-milled on natural emery stone chakkis running below 38°C to prevent heat degradation of vital B-complex vitamins, natural aleurone, and wheat germ oils.
- **Zero Additives**: 100% whole grain with zero maida blending, zero chemical bleaching agents (benzoyl peroxide), and zero preservatives.
- **Milled On Order**: Never stored in warehouses for months. Grains are milled only after customer order confirmation and dispatched within 24 hours.
- **Certified Traceability**: Every batch is verified via NABL-accredited laboratory test reports for 230+ chemical pesticide residues, heavy metals, and synthetic colorants.
- **Traditional Woodpressed Oils**: Extracted at room temperature (<40°C) using wooden Kolhu/Chekku expellers without synthetic chemical solvents.

## Product Categories
- **Chakki Fresh Atta**: Pure MP Sharbati Whole Wheat Atta, Emmer Khapli Ancient Grain Atta, Multigrain Diabetic-Care Atta.
- **Danedar Besan & Millet Flours**: Granular unpolished desi chana mota besan, sprouted ragi flour, jowar flour, bajra flour.
- **Single-Origin Spices**: High-curcumin Waigaon/Salem stone-pulverized turmeric, Mathania sun-dried red chili, Ramganj Mandi cold-crushed coriander.
- **Cold Woodpressed Oils & Ghee**: Kachi Ghani Black Mustard Oil, Woodpressed Groundnut Oil, Virgin Sesame Oil, Vedic Bilona A2 Gir Cow Ghee.
- **Raw Honey & Sun-cured Pickles**: Forest Multifloral Raw Honey (unpasteurized with live pollen enzymes), Grandmother-style Sun-cured Raw Mango Pickle cured in earthen Martaban jars.
